description: Delegate a task to a pi agent running in the background. Returns a sessionId immediately, so nothing blocks. Use `wait` for progress/results, `status` for a snapshot, `steer` to redirect, and `answer` for questions. Use this for anything that might take more than a minute.

attachments.description: Absolute paths of text files appended to the prompt, read by this server, e.g. a diff you wrote to your scratchpad; they may lie outside cwd. At most 20, 256 KiB each, 1 MiB in total; secret paths are refused.

coordinator.description: Opt-in memory-only orchestration of caller-planned read-only children. Omitted prompt gives a concise synthesis with disagreements, failed coverage and original report references; omitted tools selects codemode, subject to server permissions. Children have independent budgets and count toward concurrency. Cancelling the coordinator leaves children running.

attachments.description: Absolute text files appended to every member's prompt unless a member sets its own; each member receives a copy.

prompt.description: One question for every member, e.g. the same question to several models whose answers the coordinator compares; a member's own prompt is added after it.

research.description: Enable configured Exa search/fetch for children; requires the two exact tools in PI_DELEGATE_ALLOW_TOOLS. Off when omitted.

attachments.description: Absolute text files appended to this member's prompt; replaces the plan's attachments, [] for none.

mcpServers.description: Configured servers for this member only; selects connections, not tool grants. Not inherited from a fork or the coordinator.

prompt.description: This member's own part, added after the plan's prompt; required when the plan has none.

research.description: Override the plan's web research setting; enables only configured Exa search/fetch, subject to server tool permissions.

contextFiles.description: Absolute UTF-8 instruction files injected as project context; only these files are selected.

skills.description: Absolute skill markdown files (e.g. /repo/.pi/skills/review/SKILL.md). Requires read or bash among granted tools; only these skills are advertised, with bodies loaded on demand.

tools.description: Exact read-only built-in or reviewed MCP tools; defaults to read/grep/find/ls. MCP tools also require their server in mcpServers and host permission.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory. Required unless forkFrom supplies the parent cwd.

durable.description: Default false: memory only, nothing written, gone when this MCP process exits; right for short, cheap, re-runnable work such as reviews, searches and model comparisons. Pass true when the work is long, has external side effects, should survive an MCP restart, or needs disk retention. Memory sessions can follow_up while retained in this process.

extensions.description: Load pi extensions for this delegate. Off by default; they add startup cost and can misbehave.

fallbackModels.description: Models to continue on, in this session, when a provider error outlasts Pi's own retries: patterns such as "xai/*" or exact refs, tried in order; models of the failed provider are skipped. Omit for the server's PI_DELEGATE_FALLBACK_MODELS; [] for none.

forkFrom.description: Start a new task from a settled session's history; budgets are fresh. Omitted cwd/model/tools inherit and are revalidated, except coordinator defaults its omitted tools to codemode.

id.description: Your own session id for traceability, e.g. "search-audit-01". 1-64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:-], must start alphanumeric, must not already be in use. Defaults to a UUID.

label.description: Free-text note shown in `sessions`, e.g. what this delegate is for; never sent to the delegate

maxDurationMs.description: Wall-clock deadline in milliseconds; server ceiling 900000.

maxToolCalls.description: Own-tool-call quota shared with follow_up unless explicitly renewed there; the delegate is told its count near the cap, then must answer. Omit for no cap.

maxTurns.description: Turn quota shared with follow_up unless explicitly renewed there; server ceiling 50.

mcpServers.description: Names from Pi mcp.json to connect. Required with nativeMcp; other servers are not loaded.

model.description: Omit for the configured default. Use "provider/modelId" from the models tool to choose another.

nativeMcp.description: Enable Pi native MCP independently of third-party extensions. Requires explicit mcpServers and authorized exact tool names, including codemode/tool_search if used.

prompt.description: The task for the pi agent. Required for ordinary delegates; omit with coordinator for the default dispatch/wait/synthesis workflow. A supplied prompt replaces that default.

resources.description: Explicit instruction/skill files; omitted loads none. Forks inherit the selection; {} clears it. Does not grant tools.

contextFiles.description: Absolute UTF-8 instruction files injected as project context; only these files are selected.

skills.description: Absolute skill markdown files (e.g. /repo/.pi/skills/review/SKILL.md). Requires read or bash among granted tools; only these skills are advertised, with bodies loaded on demand.

retentionDays.description: Durable only: days to keep it on disk after it finishes (default 7, max 365). Set it longer when the user wants to come back to this session later.

saveTo.description: Absolute file path: when the run finishes, its final text is written there and results show savedTo instead

thinking.description: Explicit pi thinking level. Omit to use pi's configured/default level.

tools.description: Tool allowlist for this delegate. Omit for read, grep, find, ls; [] disables all tools. With coordinator, omit for codemode instead. Permitted on this server: read, grep, find, ls.

name: spawn
